package_name: Sign-Supported AI Tutor Avatar Sign Package
notes: Composite prototype expansion adds 34 review-only actions assembled from the repaired core motions. These additions are not SLSL transcriptions and remain needs_validation until replaced or approved by a qualified reviewer.
This package intentionally avoids procedural IK sign generation.

Arm-posture revision 2 corrects FK arm/wrist poses and transition timing in the existing 22 prototype actions. Finger key shapes are retained, but arm paths/palm orientations changed and require fresh linguistic review. No lexical signs are newly validated.
Each lexical sign must be authored/recorded/retargeted on the same Louise skeleton and validated before it is described as Sri Lankan Sign Language.
Prototype-ready educational gestures may be played in the research prototype but are not validated Sri Lankan Sign Language signs.
The research scope is sign-supported key terms and avatar actions, not full automatic sign-language translation.
Do not mark a lexical clip as validated until reviewed by a qualified Sri Lankan Sign Language reviewer/interpreter.
15 longer teaching-demo clips reuse unchanged repaired movements. They are composite topic cues, not new lexical signs or SLSL phrase translations. All require human review.
12 short explanation-topic cues concatenate unchanged existing rotations at original speed. Not new lexical signs or full sentence translations; human review required.
